interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Phuc:[/b][/color] I have news about Binh. May I step out of the rain for a moment?

response_choices: Come under the roof. Take a coffee sachet.
I will get you a coffee sachet.

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Phuc:[/b][/color] Thank you for the coffee. We have identified the man in the drainage channel.
[color=#ffffff][b]Phuc:[/b][/color] Binh. His family confirmed it this afternoon.
[color=#ffffff][b]Phuc:[/b][/color] We found a wet payment slip in his pocket. The date is readable. The signature is not.
[color=#ffffff][b]Phuc:[/b][/color] I will be at the end of the alley. Keep anything that could tell us who he went to see.
